text:
Type: glass-door display cabinet with drawers
Use: displaying dishes, glassware and books, storing linens in drawers; dining room, living room
Style: contemporary, classic, mid-century modern
Materials: dark brown stained wood veneer, clear glass doors, glass shelves, slim metal bar handle
Colors: dark chocolate brown, clear glass
Shape: tall slim cabinet with two framed glass doors over four stacked drawers, long vertical bar handle, small drawer knobs, tapered square legs, refined and upright, medium visual weight
Feel: elegant, warm, refined, calm
Goes with: white or beige walls, brass accents, cream textiles; classic, contemporary or mid-century dining rooms

product.name: REGISSR
product.description: Wood is a natural living material, and variations in the grain, colour and texture makes each piece of wood furniture unique.
